nudges.text: My market is open! I pay more than the shipping crate for anything you grow.
{crop} sells for {market} at my market right now. The crate only gave you {crate}.
{crop} is featured at my market: {market} each, the best price in town until {until}.
Wait! An order on the Board wants {crop}, and it pays much more than the crate.
Pick crops soon after they ripen and you get a Fresh Pick: a tip and extra XP.
Your barn's nearly full. I can build it bigger: find me in Town, under Land.
One of your crops has a mastery star waiting. Tap the ★ on its seed to pick a bonus.
Your field sat empty while you were away. Plant a long crop before you go, and it'll be ready when you're back.

tips.text: The crate is for when you're in a hurry. Pip's market pays better, and the Board pays best.
Market prices change at midnight, 8 am and 4 pm. A bad price now might be a good one later.
The featured crop at the market always pays 165%. Worth growing a few extra.
A full barn ships crops at crate price. Sell what you don't need before it fills.
Orders never expire. Fill the ones that suit you and pass on the rest.
Passing on an order is free. A new one goes up on the next tick.
Hand in each line of the gold Special as soon as you have it. It doesn't all have to be at once.
Harvest soon after crops ripen for a Fresh Pick. Neighbours tip for fresh food.
Planted the wrong seed? Tap it again within 3 seconds for a full refund.
Replant All puts the last crop back in every empty plot. One tap and you're done.
Drag your finger across plots to plant or harvest a whole row at once.
Before bed, plant your longest crop. It'll be waiting in the morning.
Short crops pay more per hour, but only if you're around to replant them.
Look at a seed's grow time and ask yourself when you'll be back. Plant for that.
Branches give wood and rocks give stone. Clear them even when you don't need the space.
Better soil grows crops faster. Upgrade the plots you use most first.
Fertilizer doubles one harvest. Use it on your most valuable crop, not radishes.
Flour is worth more than the wheat that made it. Let your buildings do the work.
Start a batch in every building before you put the phone down.
Everybody has a favourite gift. Loved gifts count far more than ordinary ones.
Five hearts with a friend brings a perk that lasts forever.
Ziggy sells seeds before you could normally grow them. Expensive, but sometimes worth it.
Each mastery star is a choice. Coins is safe; Quick Growth suits a farmer who checks in often.
Not happy with a crop's stars? Redo them once a week from its page in the Almanac.
Tap the little visitors on your crops. Five pollen makes a honey.
Honey sells well and neighbours ask for it. Keep a jar or two in the barn.
Bites build up at the creek while you're away. Stop by when you check your crops.
Some fish only bite in the evening. Nell knows which.
Every town level raises the price of everything you sell. Help with the weekly project.
Ribbons buy extra building slots. More slots, more goods while you're away.
Start a crock of pickles before bed. They take hours, and they'll be ready by morning.
Twelve radishes make a jar of pickles. Radishes grow fast, and pickles sell for more.
Get to 3 hearts with a friend and they might share a recipe card.
A quilt takes all night, but it pays the most for each cotton.
A second line lets a building make two things at once. Expensive, but it doubles what you make.
